title: decachaena ursina
intro: Decachaena ursina, commonly known as the hairy daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Decachaena ursina include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and relieve cough and congestion, making it a potential natural remedy for respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
